name: Umidera Aoi
source: 2nd year student. Usana's childhood friend. The daughter of the head of Naniwa Shokai, a Kansai trading company. She looks stupid, but is actually even stupider, but she has good luck, which is how she survives. As a genuine Kansai person, Tsuutenkaku sometimes grows from her head.
